teachOnceBody: Start Class, show the QR, and teach in English. Students hear and read Spanish on their phones.
stepSpeakBody: Tap Start Class. A QR code and join code appear on your screen.
stepSpeakWake: Leave Keep screen awake on when your browser supports it. A locked phone can still stop the microphone; that is an OS limit.
stepInterpretBody: Your English is translated once into Spanish captions and voice.
stepFollowBody: Students scan the QR, join, and listen. They can ask you a question.
stepFollowLesson: When class ends, review the bilingual transcript and draft lesson plan, then publish a private link if needed.
promise: Start a class. Share the code. Be understood.
illustrative: Start Class opens a real class.
exampleEnglish: Today we will discuss the word mysterion.
exampleSpanish: Hoy hablaremos de la palabra mysterion.
studentsFree: Students join with the class code.
simulated: Simulated mode. Speech and translation are not live.
interpretBody: Sends one English sentence to Spanish.
liveNote: AI-generated voice. Translation may contain errors.
classLiveHint: Tell them: scan the QR, type Tu nombre, tap Masculino or Femenino, then Entrar a la clase. To ask: tap Hacer una pregunta, speak, then Detener.
joinMissing: That code did not match a live class.
joinWaiting: Waiting for the teacher. Tap Tap to hear if needed.
classTypedOnly: You can type a line if needed.
headsetHint: Choose your headset in phone sound settings.
micFailed: That audio could not be used.
studentSpeakHint: Tap to ask the teacher a question.
studentBusy: Wait a moment, then try again.
questionInboxHint: Tap a name to hear the question.
endQuestionsWarn: Ending deletes student questions from this class.
installClassAppBody: Download the BabelBeam Class App so the phone can keep the screen on during class instead of dimming or locking while you teach.
installAlreadyInApp: You are already in the Class App. Leave Keep screen awake on while you teach.
installAndroidBody: Best option for teachers on Android. The app wraps BabelBeam and uses native keep-awake during class.
installAndroidStep2Body: Open the APK. Allow install from this source if Android asks.
installAndroidStep3Body: Open BabelBeam Class, start class, leave Keep screen awake on.
installAndroidSideload: This is a direct APK for the parish pilot, not a Play Store listing yet.
installIosAppBody: A signed iPhone Class App needs Apple TestFlight approval. Until then, add BabelBeam to the Home Screen and leave Keep screen awake on while teaching.
installDesktop1: Open babelbeam.com in Chrome or Edge.
installDesktop2: Use Add to Home Screen or the browser menu.
installAfter: Choose your headset in sound settings.
installLimitsBody: The Class App is meant to stop the screen from going black during class. It does not claim capture continues after you force-lock the phone or after the OS stops background audio.
classAppCta: Get Class App for screen stay-on
qrAlt: QR code for students to join this class
linkCopyFailed: Could not copy. Read the code aloud.
endConfirm: End this class? Student questions will be deleted.
tapToHearReply: Tap to hear the English reply
keepAwakeInactive: Screen stay-awake paused. Return to BabelBeam to resume.
keepAwakeUnsupported: This browser cannot keep the screen awake.
keepAwakeBlocked: Screen stay-awake was blocked. Check battery or power settings.
keepAwakeLimit: Keeping the screen awake only works while BabelBeam is open in front. A locked phone may still stop the microphone. That is an OS limit, not a BabelBeam setting.
questionSound: Play a soft sound for new questions
micOnTeacher: Microphone on. Pause briefly after each sentence.
heardSpanish: Heard Spanish from a speaker. Not sent again.
classGone: This class is closed. Start a new class.
classGoneStudent: This class is closed. Ask for a new code.
codeReady: Code ready. Enter your name and join.
helpAi: AI-generated voice. Translation may contain errors.
helpNotChat: BabelBeam is an interpreter, not a chatbot.
aiDisclaimer: AI-generated voice. Translation may contain errors.
constraints: Install BabelBeam, then choose your headset in sound settings.
dashboardBody: Start Class, then share the QR code.
fillerSkipped: That was only filler. Try again.
lessonMissing: This lesson link is missing or expired.
lessonRetention: Text transcript kept up to {days} days. Audio is not stored by default.
lessonTranscriptHint: Recognized English and delivered Spanish stay separate. Rate samples for quality review.
lessonQuizHint: Quizzes are optional and only created when you ask.
lessonShareHint: Private by default. Publish a revocable link after you review the plan.
lessonTextPhoneHint: Optional. Leave blank to pick a contact in Messages.
lessonTextHint: Opens Messages with the lesson link ready. Tap Send in Messages to deliver it.
lessonTextOpened: Messages opened with the lesson link.
lessonPublishNeedOutline: Save a lesson plan draft before publishing.
